digest.summary: US stocks fell sharply on 2026-11-20 as an AI chip rout deepened and the Nasdaq erased its 2026 gains. Headlines cite Nvidia's seven-session slide after a Reuters report of an SEC accounting probe, a California subpoena to Nvidia, and weak trading in Anthropic after its record IPO. Expectations of another Fed rate hike were also cited as weighing on tech shares, and the S&P 500 and Dow were reported in correction territory.
digest.fed_note: A headline cites rising expectations for another Federal Reserve rate hike, and the October FOMC minutes were released on 2026-11-18 without further detail in the headlines.
digest.sector_note: Headlines say investors have moved into Treasuries and defensive positions, but they do not specifically explain why consumer staples are holding up.
